In this special episode of Guest In The Newsroom, renowned bhajan singer Lakhbir Singh Lakha opens up about the stories, inspirations and untold secrets behind some of his most popular devotional songs.
From the making of iconic bhajans like Pyara Saja Hai Tera Dwar Bhawani, Ambe Tu Hai Jagdambe and Shree Ram Janki, to the fascinating musical inspirations drawn from Bollywood songs and Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan's Qawwalis, Lakha reveals how these timeless bhajans came into existence.
